mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM travel_cards WHERE id = #{travelCardId} AND is_active = TRUE AND is_deleted = 0 )

SELECT utc.id AS user_travel_card_id, utc.travel_card_id, utc.card_name, utc.issuer_name, utc.masked_card_number, utc.brand_name, utc.card_color FROM user_travel_cards utc WHERE utc.user_id = #{userId} AND utc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND utc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY utc.id

SELECT wtc.id AS wallet_travel_card_id, wtc.user_travel_card_id, wtc.travel_card_id, wtc.card_name, wtc.issuer_name, wtc.masked_card_number, wtc.status FROM wallet_travel_card wtc WHERE wtc.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND wtc.status = 'LINKED' ORDER BY wtc.linked_at DESC, wtc.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, wallet_id, user_travel_card_id, travel_card_id, card_name, issuer_name, masked_card_number, status, linked_at, unlinked_at FROM wallet_travel_card WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND status = 'LINKED' ORDER BY linked_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, wallet_id, user_travel_card_id, travel_card_id, card_name, issuer_name, masked_card_number, status, linked_at, unlinked_at FROM wallet_travel_card WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND id = #{walletTravelCardId} AND status = 'LINKED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_travel_card ( wallet_id, user_travel_card_id, travel_card_id, card_name, issuer_name, masked_card_number, status ) SELECT #{walletId}, utc.id, COALESCE(utc.travel_card_id, tc.id), utc.card_name, utc.issuer_name, COALESCE(#{maskedCardNumber}, utc.masked_card_number), #{status} FROM user_travel_cards utc LEFT JOIN travel_cards tc ON tc.id = utc.travel_card_id AND tc.is_active = TRUE AND tc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE utc.id = #{userTravelCardId} AND utc.travel_card_id = #{travelCardId} AND utc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND utc.is_deleted = 0 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_travel_card_id = VALUES(user_travel_card_id), card_name = VALUES(card_name), issuer_name = VALUES(issuer_name), masked_card_number = VALUES(masked_card_number), status = 'LINKED', unlinked_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_travel_card SET status = 'UNLINKED', unlinked_at = NOW() WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND status = 'LINKED'
mapper.select: SELECT currency_code, balance_amount, krw_estimated_amount FROM travel_card_balance WHERE wallet_travel_card_id = #{walletTravelCardId} ORDER BY currency_code

SELECT id AS ledger_id, currency_code, direction, transaction_type, foreign_amount, balance_before, balance_after, memo, created_at FROM travel_card_ledger WHERE wallet_travel_card_id = #{walletTravelCardId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, balance_amount, krw_estimated_amount, updated_at FROM travel_card_balance WHERE wallet_travel_card_id = #{walletTravelCardId} AND currency_code = #{currencyCode} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_card_balance ( wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, balance_amount, krw_estimated_amount ) VALUES ( #{walletTravelCardId}, #{currencyCode}, #{balanceAmount}, #{krwEstimatedAmount} )
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_card_balance SET balance_amount = #{balanceAmount}, krw_estimated_amount = #{krwEstimatedAmount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{balanceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_card_ledger ( wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, direction, transaction_type, foreign_amount, balance_before, balance_after, source_type, source_id, target_type, target_id, idempotency_key, memo ) VALUES ( #{walletTravelCardId}, #{currencyCode}, #{direction}, #{transactionType}, #{foreignAmount}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{memo} )

INSERT INTO wallet_card_topup ( wallet_id, wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, krw_amount, foreign_amount, status, idempotency_key, external_transaction_id, retry_count, last_tried_at, completed_at, wallet_ledger_id, card_ledger_id, refunded ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{walletTravelCardId}, #{currencyCode}, #{krwAmount}, #{foreignAmount}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{externalTransactionId}, #{retryCount}, #{lastTriedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{walletLedgerId}, #{cardLedgerId}, #{refunded} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, wallet_id, wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, krw_amount, foreign_amount, status, idempotency_key, external_transaction_id, retry_count, last_tried_at, requested_at, completed_at, failed_at, failure_reason, wallet_ledger_id, card_ledger_id, refunded, created_at, updated_at FROM wallet_card_topup WHERE id = #{topupId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, wallet_id, wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, krw_amount, foreign_amount, status, idempotency_key, external_transaction_id, retry_count, last_tried_at, requested_at, completed_at, failed_at, failure_reason, wallet_ledger_id, card_ledger_id, refunded, created_at, updated_at FROM wallet_card_topup WHERE status IN ('REQUESTED', 'PROCESSING', 'FAILED') AND refunded = FALSE AND completed_at IS NULL AND retry_count < 3 ORDER BY updated_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_card_topup SET status = 'PROCESSING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_tried_at = NOW(), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{topupId} AND status IN ('REQUESTED', 'PROCESSING', 'FAILED')

UPDATE wallet_card_topup SET status = 'COMPLETED', external_transaction_id = #{externalTransactionId}, completed_at = NOW(), failed_at = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, wallet_ledger_id = #{walletLedgerId}, card_ledger_id = #{cardLedgerId}, refunded = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{topupId}
UPDATE wallet_card_topup SET status = 'FAILED', failed_at = NOW(), failure_reason = #{failureReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{topupId}
UPDATE wallet_card_topup SET status = 'REFUNDED', wallet_ledger_id = COALESCE(wallet_ledger_id, #{walletLedgerId}), refunded = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{topupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_exchange_transaction ( wallet_id, wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, exchange_type, krw_amount, foreign_amount, base_exchange_rate, applied_exchange_rate, fee_rate, fee_amount, status, completed_at, wallet_ledger_id, card_ledger_id ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{walletTravelCardId}, #{currencyCode}, #{exchangeType}, #{krwAmount}, #{foreignAmount}, #{baseExchangeRate}, #{appliedExchangeRate}, #{feeRate}, #{feeAmount}, #{status}, #{completedAt}, #{walletLedgerId}, #{cardLedgerId} )
mapper.select: SELECT er.deal_base_rate FROM exchange_rates er INNER JOIN currencies c ON c.id = er.target_currency_id WHERE c.currency_code = #{currencyCode} ORDER BY er.rate_date DESC, er.created_at DESC, er.id DESC LIMIT 1
